__own.description: A shoulder tank in bare steel, a braided feed line and a heavily shielded nozzle. Analogue gauge. Stencilled down the tank: VULCAN ORDNANCE - PYRE-3 INCINERATION PROJECTOR - LICENSED CLEARANCE WORK ONLY. Scratched under it: IT DOES NOT KNOW WHAT YOU MEANT.
__own.dry_message: The igniter cracks on nothing and the nozzle coughs a thin unlit mist across the floor.
__own.reload_message: You crack the spent canister out of the tank, seat a fresh one on the bayonet collar, and wait for the pressure light. It goes green.
